title: SREV-022 font token subject context rewrite

object_reference_shape.description: ObReferenceObject increments object reference count; caller must decrement via ObDereferenceObject

primary_token_shape.description: PsReferencePrimaryToken must be balanced by ObDereferenceObject or PsDereferencePrimaryToken

subject_context_invariant.description: Drivers must not directly modify ACCESS_STATE or directly modify/inspect SECURITY_SUBJECT_CONTEXT members; supported posture uses SeCaptureSubjectContext / SeReleaseSubjectContext

local_compatibility_shape.description: File_ReplaceTokenIfFontRequest handles delayed kernel-mode win32k font opens with a scoped fallback that substitutes proc->primary_token into AccessState->SubjectSecurityContext.ClientToken, raises impersonation level, marks callback dirty, and returns a FILE_FONT_TOKEN_SWAP for owner-local restore/dereference

no_blind_patch_posture.description: A naked ObDereferenceObject beside the reference call risks Digital Guardian BSOD or token lifetime bug; the source-level route is scoped fallback plus minifilter/XP continuation restore before Windows runtime proof

runtime_matrix.description: Windows runtime gate: sandboxed GDI font load works; Digital Guardian callback path does not BSOD; repeated font opens do not grow token references or pool; minifilter and XP parse-proc paths verified independently

shared_runtime_capture_schema.description: Runtime evidence records use docs/plan/srev-022-027-kernel-runtime-capture.schema.json with feature_path font-token-subject-context

contracts: Driver must not modify ACCESS_STATE or SECURITY_SUBJECT_CONTEXT directly to make security decisions
Every successful token reference must be matched by ObDereferenceObject or PsDereferencePrimaryToken
Token reference behavior must not change until Windows runtime proves both font compatibility and reference ownership
default FontTokenMode auto scoped path must restore and dereference the substituted token through owner-local continuation points
FontTokenMode legacy preserves the old unscoped compatibility behavior as a regression escape hatch
FontTokenMode strict or off disables the unsupported subject-context rewrite
minifilter IRP_MJ_CREATE must pass FILE_FONT_TOKEN_SWAP through CompletionContext to a post-create restore path
legacy XP parse-proc must wrap the system parse continuation and restore after it returns
Source comments must not describe the active path as replacing PrimaryToken in ACCESS_STATE because the implementation prefers ClientToken in SECURITY_SUBJECT_CONTEXT
Minifilter pre-operation continuation and XP parse-proc continuation may need different owner-local restore/release mechanisms
runtime capture must prove who owns the substituted token reference after the unsupported subject-context rewrite before any release or restore behavior change
shared kernel runtime capture records must use feature_path font-token-subject-context

builds: XP or Server 2003 target when file_xp.c remains supported
path_topologies: legacy XP parse-proc path through file_xp.c
access_masks: unrelated read path outside font compatibility
path_classes: sandbox-boxed font path from the GDI helper
token_state: object reference delta before and after create path
failure_controls: Digital Guardian or equivalent callback-sensitive endpoint regression
